results.title: Robot Policy Evaluation for Sim-to-Real Transfer: A Benchmarking Perspective
results.snippet: Current vision-based robotics simulation benchmarks have significantly advanced robotic manipulation research. However, robotics is fundamentally a real-world problem, and evaluation for real-world applications has lagged behind in evaluating generalist policies. In this paper, we discuss challenges and desiderata in designing benchmarks for generalist robotic manipulation policies for the goal of sim-to-real policy transfer. results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. results.title: Real-Time QP Solvers: A Concise Review and Practical Guide Towards Legged Robots
results.snippet: Quadratic programming (QP) underpins real-time robotics by enabling efficient, constrained optimization in state estimation, motion planning, and control. In legged locomotion and manipulation, essential modules like inverse dynamics, Model Predictive Control (MPC), and Whole-Body Control (WBC) are inherently QP-based, demanding reliable solutions amid tight timing, energy, and computational resources on embedded platforms. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis and benchmarking study of QP solvers for legged robotics. We begin by formulating the standard convex QP and classify solvers…

results.title: One-Shot Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation with Interactive Replay
results.snippet: Recently, model-free reinforcement learning algorithms have been shown to solve challenging problems by learning from extensive interaction with the environment. A significant issue with transferring this success to the robotics domain is that interaction with the real world is costly, but training on limited experience is prone to overfitting. We present a method for learning to navigate, to a fixed goal and in a known environment, on a mobile robot. The robot leverages an interactive world model built from a single traversal of the environment, a pre-trained visual feature encoder, and stoc…

results.title: Surgical Vision ROS2: a ROS2 Humble pipeline for intraoperative wound assessment and variable-autonomy arm control
results.snippet:
Abstract 
                 Surgical Vision ROS2 is a ROS2 Humble pipeline for intraoperative wound assessment. A vision node scores a wound using a five-part ABCDE framework adapted from dermatology. A behaviour manager converts the score into one of three autonomy tiers for a MoveIt2-controlled arm: full execution, reduced-speed execution with per-motion confirmation, and a hold state in which the arm freezes until the operator types CONFIRM. On a 45-image synthetic benchmark the original grayscale adaptive-threshold segmentation reached 6.7% three-class verdict accuracy. Inspection showed t…

report_md:
# 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 生态前沿快照（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-10-28（UTC）  
**领域**：具身智能 / 机器人运动学与控制 / ROS 2 生态  
**检索源数量**：33 条可引用来源（编号 [1]-[33]）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 实时二次规划（QP）求解器系统性综述——MPC/WBC/逆动力学的数值核心
2025 年出现首份面向腿式机器人的实时 QP 求解器综述，系统梳理了模型预测控制（MPC）、全身控制（WBC）、逆动力学等核心模块对 QP 求解器的工程选型依据 [11]。该综述指出 QP 是实时机器人控制的基础数值内核，并给出求解器对比与实用指南。

| 维度 | 证据 |
|------|------|
| **热度证据** | citations=0（发布 10 天内），GitHub star 暂无公开仓库 [11] |
| **权威证据** | arXiv 预印本 (cs.RO)，非同行评审 [11] |
| **关注度** | 中：最新综述直击 MPC/WBC 工程落地痛点，社区关注度仍在积累 [11] |
| **推荐度** | ★★★★☆：核心数值方法综述，工程选型参考价值高 [11] |

### 1.2 真机泛化策略基准测试新范式——RSS 2025 Workshop 共识
RSS 2025 Workshop 论文提出面向仿真-真机迁移的基准设计三大准则：高视觉保真仿真、任务复杂度系统递增、仿真-真机性能对齐量化 [3]。这为 MPC/RL 等控制算法的真机 SOTA 声称提供了学术共识评估标尺。

| 维度 | 证据 |
|------|------|
| **热度证据** | Workshop 论文，引用数暂未公开 [3] |
| **权威证据** | RSS 2025 Workshop（同行评审会议研讨会） [3] |
| **关注度** | 中：聚焦真机评测基准这一公认痛点，但为 Workshop 非主会长文 [3] |
| **推荐度** | ★★★☆☆：提供基准选型参考框架，建议跟踪后续主会长文与开源基准套件 [3] |

### 1.3 人形机器人全身操作与遥操作的最新算法突破（2025-2026）
- **无机器人演示的全身操作**：提出从纯人类视频演示学习人形全身操作，绕过遥操作硬件后勤与复杂奖励工程 [23]  
- **退火 RL 课程学习羽毛球**：展示统一全身策略实现动态真实世界交互（击打高速移动羽毛球）[25]  
- **CHILD 全身遥操作系统**：支持人形机器人关节级全身遥操作，扩展可完成任务多样性 [26]  
- **约束全身跟踪**：ConstrainedMimic 框架在训练后强制满足安全约束，推进 RL 策略的真机安全部署 [27]

| 维度 | 证据 |
|------|------|

### 1.4 实时全身控制与硬件/算法协同设计
- **MPPI 全身控制**：基于模型预测路径积分控制实现腿式机器人实时全身控制 [10]

- **NVIDIA Isaac Lab 2.3**：集成全身控制与增强遥操作，简化机器人学习流水线 [28]

## 3. 蓝海与缺口

### 3.1 统一真机基准榜单缺失
候选证据未覆盖 2024-2026 年真机上 MPC/WBC/RL 控制算法的统一基准榜单与可复现 SOTA 表格 [q1-open]。RSS Workshop 刚提出框架 [3]，但尚无公认榜单。

> 待核实：是否已有第三方整理的真机 MPC/WBC/RL 对比表（如 GitHub Awesome 列表或基准网站）。

### 3.2 ROS 2 核心运动学/控制库成熟度系统性调研空白
缺乏关于 Lie 群运动学、操作空间控制、全身 QP 控制器在 ROS 2 (Humble/Iron/Jazzy) 中成熟开源实现的系统性调研资料 [q2-open]。  
缺乏 `ros2_control` 硬件抽象层演进现状、最佳实践与主流本体（人形、灵巧手、移动操作）适配情况的权威来源 [q2-open]。  
缺乏 MoveIt2、Pinocchio、Eigen、CppAD、OCS2、WBC 等核心库在 ROS 2 新版本中的集成成熟度对比 [q2-open]。

### 3.3 灵巧手/柔性物体长时程操作的真机泛化
尽管有分类学与基准 [33]，但灵巧手在非结构化环境下的长时程柔性物体操作（如电缆、布料）真机泛化仍为无人区。

### 3.4 无机器人演示学习的数据效率与物理一致性
[23] 提出从纯人类视频学习，但跨本体几何重定向、动力学一致性保证、视觉域随机化需求仍为开放问题。

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

### 4.1 实时最优控制求解器的计算预算与鲁棒性权衡
QP 求解器综述 [11] 揭示：高频 MPC（>1kHz）对求解器数值稳定性、热启动质量、稀疏结构利用提出极高要求；硬件/算法协同设计 [17] 成为突破口但工程复杂度高。

### 4.2 Sim2Real 间隙的三大维度
RSS Workshop [3] 明确指出：视觉保真度、任务复杂度系统性、仿真-真机性能对齐量化——三者缺一不可。当前多数工作仅解决单一维度。

### 4.3 奖励工程与硬件后勤的双重瓶颈
人形全身操作 RL 依赖复杂奖励工程 [23] 与遥操作硬件后勤 [26]，限制技能多样性与数据规模扩展。

### 4.4 安全约束的训练后强制满足
ConstrainedMimic [27] 指出：RL 策略训练后强制满足新增安全约束（如关节限位、碰撞避免）仍为开放难题，关乎真机部署合规。

### 4.5 拐点信号
- **Isaac Lab 等平台集成 WBC** [28] 降低工程门槛，可能引发 WBC 从“科研模块”向“标准组件”转型  
- **扩散策略与域随机化** [24] 在全身控制中显示出比传统 RL 更强的泛化潜力  
- **弱硬实时 ROS 2 支持** [22] 成熟将解锁工业级确定性控制部署
